shorts.script: Mexico's high-pressing defense and midfield mastery prove too much for South Africa, securing a 2-0 win and taking control of Group A.
Mexico's midfield pivot dictates the tempo of the game, completing 93% of his passes and providing the crucial assist for the breakthrough goal.

shorts.hook: Group A just got a whole lot interesting!
shorts.script: Mexico's statement win sends shockwaves through the tournament, setting up an exciting finale and leaving South Africa with a must-win situation.
